capability_radar.watch: First separately authorised scientific MAIN reads the block pairs; no automatic A/B repeat.

dimensions.build_vs_buy: ADOPT the one episode evaluator, cohort seats and downside helper; no new engine, API, scheduler or statistics stack.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One task contract; no PRD/SSD duplication.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Descriptive readout only; no alpha, NetReturn, promotion or cashflow claim.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: New episode calculation version V4; V3 and older stay current and readable, are never recomputed, revised or re-hashed.
dimensions.mission: Let the next episode MAIN tell a weak shape from a bad market day by saving matched next to its own comparator per day and cohort.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Rollback after a V4 result exists is forward-fix only: keep a V4 reader, delete no history.
dimensions.owner_operability: discovery-show returns every saved paired row; the bounded readout shows four paired rows with honest truncation and state counts.
dimensions.red_team: Pooled and block-local comparisons can point in opposite directions; pairs are descriptive, not a decomposition, replication or causal claim; inclusive reference without an unmatched observation is typed, not a zero difference.
dimensions.research_truth: Reference is the query's native comparator (baseline includes matched, complement excludes it); quantiles and ES10 are never averaged or subtracted; missing targets stay counts.
dimensions.security: No credentials, network, provider calls or canonical writes.

recovery: Forward-fix only once a V4 result is saved; before that an ordinary revert.
